title: aiohttp-valera-validator was renamed and is no longer maintained
summary: The maintainer states that aiohttp-valera-validator is no longer maintained and was renamed to aiohttp-d42-validator.

constraints: Preserve request parameter, query, body, and response validation; schema semantics; aiohttp middleware behavior; and error responses.

steps.title: Move to aiohttp-d42-validator
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution, update imports to aiohttp_d42_validator, and translate schemas and decorators to the renamed package.

verification.purpose: Run valid and invalid request, schema, response, middleware, and project tests when defined.
